services.name: Boat Rental
services.desc: Just purchased and ready to go, this brand-new pontoon boat can take you, your friends, and your family all over the beautiful waters of the Lower Keys. Spend a day at the sandbar, do some snorkeling, fish, or just relax in the sun. Call the one and only Rocky Ramirez, who will guide you with recommendations and local knowledge for a great Key West local adventure. Includes: private captain, food and drinks, plus fuel!

At Paradise Boat rentals, you rent your own boat and you are the captain.
